en-US.name: Energy Display
en-US.summary: Show live energy data from your Home Assistant on your Echo Show.
en-US.description: Energy Display shows solar, grid, battery and home energy from your own Home Assistant server as a full-screen view and as a home screen widget. It needs the Alexa Energy Display custom integration in Home Assistant.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask energy display to refresh
Alexa, ask energy display to open the dashboard
